correctness.rationale: Via the finite Birkhoff ideal representation J(P), the pseudocomplement is the downset whose principal ideals avoid I. The Boolean center is exactly unions of comparability components, giving 2^c excluded-middle solutions; every negation depends only on membership among m minima and its image equals the double-negation fixed set, giving 2^m regular elements and q/p=2^(m-c). Connected components with t minima admit precisely N>=2^t+1 ideals if t>=2 (star with upper chain realizes each), and N>=2 when t=1. Products yield the entire pair spectrum. The inequality g(a)g(b)>=2g(a+b-1), g(1)=2, g(t)=2^t+1, proves sharp positive-defect envelopes, with equality one top above k+1 minima plus isolated points; zero defect nonboolean gives at most 2/3. Independently enumerated all naturally ordered posets of sizes 1..5, counts 1,2,7,40,357, verifying formulas and relevant envelopes. Reviewed verify_joint.py which extends checks to 5231 posets through size 6; finite checks are not universal proof.
